summary: Elite Express Holding Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Nasdaq notified it on August 6, 2026, that the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) Minimum Bid Price Requirement by maintaining a closing bid price of at least $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days. The matter is closed. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic transaction. No deal terms, advisors, or board actions are involved.
